description: ATSR-2 continued ATSR-1 sea-surface temperature observations and added three visible and near-infrared channels for land applications. Its dual-angle measurements support atmospheric correction of land-cover observations.
facility_description: ERS-2 was the ESA follow-on mission to ERS-1 and carried ATSR-2.
notes: No curve-specific terms or requested acknowledgement located on the opened ATSR project pages. CEDA archive links are available but the source of the NJM spectral response curves remains unresolved.
